title: Candidate sampling & stability gates for embedding + reranker onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: create an automated, reproducible onboarding pipeline for embedding+r eranker model pairs that includes candidate-sampling strategies, stability metrics, and gating rules before publishing performance profiles. Scope: (1) define canonical candidate sampling recipes (BM25, random shards, production-simulated prefixes); (2) implement lightweight stability checks (score variance, top-k churn, rank correlation) across version pins and quantization variants; (3) add automated conformance tests that run during model publish and fail profile release on regressions above thresholds; (4) surface failure reasons and suggested mitigations in the Console publish UI and in the onboarding webhook payload; (5) integrate profiling job results into the model catalog so downstream routing can prefer stable variants. Out-of-scope: full integration with Dedicated autoscaler (follow-up). Success criteria: reproducible candidate sampling artifacts in storage, a CI job that publishes a "profile-publish-failure" artifact when gates fail, <5% false positives across 10 manually validated onboarding cases, documentation for PMs and solutions engineers, and a canary rollout plan for the profile publisher. Working assumptions: production sampling can be approximated via synthetic prefixes + small production trace; we will store candidate sets per-run for auditability; thresholds will be configurable per-customer. Deliverables: onboarding pipeline code, new conformance test suite, Console UI messaging, Confluence runbook, and a regression dashboard in Grafana.
comments: 2026-03-06 - Quick spike: implemented BM25 + random shard samplers; verified deterministic seeding for reproducible candidate sets (PR: github.com/redwoodinc/inference/pulls/3142).
